t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes who give out yellow baskets (blue,green,yellow,orange) get you most points on 5x multiplier round. The others, red, brown, red, and pink, give red baskets.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes are split in to two groups. There is the blue, green, orange and yellow gnomes. And there is the pink, red, brown and purple gnomes. Selecting either a blue, green, orange or yellow gnome gives you a yellow basket, while selecting either a pink, red, brown and purple gnome gives you a red basket. The amount of mushrooms that follow each colour of basket changes half the time. That is, when one basket elicits more points/mushrooms, it will so several times in a row (e.g. points of 15+). When points start decreasing, start selecting the other basket (i.e. the other group of gnomes), as this will give more points for several gos.
